title: Egyptian Sushi Roll
description: A unique fusion of Egyptian and sushi flavors in a roll. The spicy kick of the wicked seasoning pairs well with the savory flavor of the cheese.

ingredients.name: Egyptian flatbread
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

ingredients.name: Sushi rice
ingredients.notes: prepared according to sushi rice instructions

ingredients.name: Cheese
ingredients.notes: any type of cheese works, but mozzarella is recommended

ingredients.name: Pickled turnips
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to the instructions.
Cut the Egyptian flatbread into thin strips.
Mix the wicked seasoning with the shredded cheese.
Add the pickled turnips to the cheese mixture and mix well.
Lay a sheet of sushi nori flat on a cutting board.
Spread a thin layer of sushi rice onto the nori.
Place a few strips of the Egyptian flatbread on top of the rice.
Add the cheese-pickled turnip mixture on top of the flatbread.
Roll the sushi using a bamboo sushi mat.
Slice into individual rolls and garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
